notes.title: DECEMBER 1st BETA UPDATE
notes.content: I was not able to get as much done, BUT, the shield gnomes are in as place holders, not fully functional.  More tweaks and changes to the UI are in the horizon~ Getting enough time before the 1st of December was a challenge.  9 missions is the goal~ more gnomes and mini games are next~ followed by an ending sequence after a big boss~  Suggestions are welcome~
